name: LawGlance
description: RAG-based legal assistant that answers questions about Indian law from a curated set of statutes.
whatItDoes: Answers plain-language legal questions grounded in sources such as the Indian Constitution and other national acts. It is meant to make legal information more accessible to the public, not to replace a lawyer.
howItWorks: A LangChain retrieval pipeline looks up relevant passages from an indexed corpus of legal texts and has an OpenAI model compose the answer. A Streamlit app provides the chat UI and a FastAPI backend is also included; Redis caching of chat history and responses is optional.
